config.description: Set-and-forget configuration: columns, row geometry, UI text.

columns.description: The columns, rendered in array order. Each column reads `field` from every row object.

field.description: Row-object key this column displays. Columns with an empty field are ignored.

header.description: Header text. Empty = the field name.

pinned.description: Freeze this column at the left edge while the grid scrolls horizontally.

rowHeight.description: Row height in px (clamped 20–80). Fixed row height is what makes row virtualization exact.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for built-in UI text (and, later, number/date formatting). Empty = the browser locale.

loading.description: Show the thin loading bar and dim the rows (stale-while-revalidate) — bind to your query's loading state.

emptyMessage.description: Badge text when the grid is configured but has no rows. The default ('No rows') follows the locale packs (labels.noRows); any other text overrides it, and '' hides the badge.

labels.description: Per-key overrides for built-in UI text. Unset keys follow config.locale (en/fr/de/es/nl/it/pt).

noRows.description: Empty-badge text (the emptyMessage default follows it).

data.description: The grid's content. The grid never mutates rows — editing (M2) will fire events for the author to persist.

rows.description: Row objects (client-side model, virtualized rendering; intended for up to ~50k rows). Bind a query returning objects, or transform a dataset.
